text:
claire: Quick sync thread for the launch landing velocity playbook. Need final hero + 3 micro-bullets + CTA per mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + exact form field names for routing. Can we lock by EOD?
ishaan: I'll share two hero takes: outcome-first and engineer-first. Posting now.
li: small UX ask: please define the checkbox text for capacity consult and the hidden field names so dev can implement without followups.
nate: routing ops: proposed hidden field = lead_mode (values: hosted, dedicated, private), hidden utm_campaign=launch_q2, checkbox = consult_request (true/false). Rules: if lead_mode=="hosted" -> queue: hosted_trial; else -> enterprise_engage. If consult_request=="true" -> tag: high_touch.
marta: benchmark blurbs: (1) latency-first: median tail 30ms; (2) batch embeddings: 3.1x throughput; (3) regulated: isolated control plane + audit log retention. I'll provide a short methodology line for each.
ishaan: hero drafts:
- Hosted (outcome): H1: "Ship LLM features, skip the infra." H2: "Hosted API with predictable latency and usage pricing." CTA: "Try Hosted"
- Dedicated (engineer): H1: "Dedicated capacity, predictable throughput." H2: "Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed latency targets." CTA: "Request Capacity"
- Private: H1: "Private inference in your network." H2: "VPC, KMS, and audit-grade controls." CTA: "Talk to Sales"
li: sounds good. Micro-CTA under bullets: "See benchmark" linking to the blog. Form field copy: name, email, company (optional), workload_type (dropdown), est_monthly_tokens (optional), consult_request (checkbox). Placeholder examples available in drive.
nate: sample webhook for eng:
`POST /lead-capture`
`payload: { name, email, company, lead_mode, consult_request, utm_campaign }`
`routing: if payload.lead_mode == \"hosted\" assign_queue=\"hosted_trial\" else assign_queue=\"enterprise_engage\"; if payload.consult_request == \"true\" tag=\"high_touch\"`
claire: timeline recap: Marta benchmark cards by tomorrow morning, Ishaana finish hero assets today, Li finalize microcopy now, Nate wire SFDC + webhook by EOD. I'll stitch launch posts + webinar outline after. Post back here when tasks done.
deploy-bot: pages-deploy: staging deploy scheduled 2026-06-09T18:00Z; social-posts-scheduler queued 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC; holding for manual release.
li: uploaded microcopy doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/microcopy_v3.docx
marta: benchmark drafts uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/velocity_launch (comments open)
ishaan: uploading hero comps to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/velocity-hero-variants
ate: SFDC queues confirmed: hosted_trial, enterprise_engage. Added automation: if est_monthly_tokens > 50_000_000 -> predicted_arr=high -> notify_sdr=true.
claire: thanks everyone, will do a final sweep once staging copy is live. :rocket:
